wiener.description: LIGHTSTACK 0.4.0 build_kernel (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Andressa Wille, Thallis Pessi) restated with scipy.fft: both PSFs times their factor, zero-padded to shape at N//2 - n//2, ifftshift, fft2, F_t conj(F_s) / (|F_s|^2 + eps), real ifft2, fftshift, divided by the sum

window.description: a photutils run: photutils.psf_matching.make_kernel(source, target, regularization, window) with the window class named by each case (SplitCosineBellWindow, CosineBellWindow, TukeyWindow, TopHatWindow, HanningWindow)
